business_summary: Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells welding, cutting, and brazing products in the United States and internationally. It operates in three segments: Americas Welding, International Welding, and The Harris Products Group. The company offers brazing and soldering filler metals, arc welding equipment, plasma and oxyfuel cutting systems, wire feeding systems, fume control equipment, welding accessories, specialty gas regulators, and education solutions; and a portfolio of automated solutions and system integration services for joining, cutting, material handling, module assembly, and end of line testing, as well as is involved in brazing and soldering alloys, and in the retail business. It also provides mobile power solutions, including vehicle-mounted compressors, generators, welders, hydraulics, charger/boosters, and electrified power equipment; automated welding system and solutions; and specialty welding consumables, wear plates, and maintenance and repair services for alloy and wear-resistant products, as well as develops and integrates autonomous guided vehicles and mobile robots, custom assembly and test systems, and proprietary manufacturing execution system software. The company serves general fabrication, oil and gas, power generation, process, automotive and transportation, and construction and infrastructure industries, as well as heavy fabrication, ship building, and maintenance and repair markets. It sells its products directly to users of welding products, including OEMs, manufacturers, and integrators, as well as through industrial distributors, retailers, and agents. Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio.
business_summary_ko: Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc.는 자회사를 통해 미국 및 해외에서 용접, 절단 및 브레이징 제품을 설계, 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. Americas Welding, International Welding, The Harris Products Group의 세 부문으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 브레이징 및 납땜 용가재, 아크 용접 장비, 플라즈마 및 산소 연료 절단 시스템, 와이어 공급 시스템, 연기 제어 장비, 용접 액세서리, 특수 가스 조절기 및 교육 솔루션을 제공합니다. 접합, 절단, 자재 취급, 모듈 조립, 최종 라인 테스트를 위한 자동화 솔루션 및 시스템 통합 서비스 포트폴리오는 물론 브레이징 및 납땜 합금, 소매 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 또한 차량 탑재 압축기, 발전기, 용접기, 유압 장치, 충전기/부스터 및 전기 전력 장비를 포함한 모바일 전력 솔루션도 제공합니다. 자동화된 용접 시스템 및 솔루션; 합금 및 내마모 제품에 대한 특수 용접 소모품, 마모 플레이트, 유지보수 및 수리 서비스를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 자율 가이드 차량 및 모바일 로봇, 맞춤형 조립 및 테스트 시스템을 개발 및 통합합니다.
